detail.description: What happened, in Tiehall's own words.

errors.description: For input that fails the schema: where it fails, at most the first 100 places.

retryAfter.description: For a limit, a shutdown or a busy process: the seconds to wait, as Retry-After says.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of refusal.

type.description: The problem type: a URI under https://tiehall.com/problems/ that names the kind of refusal.

bearer.description: An OAuth access token or a personal access token, in the Authorization header; for contract.report, a GitHub Actions OIDC token, the only token it takes, which needs no scope. Each operation lists the scopes its token needs.

info.description: The REST API of a Tiehall install, under /api/v1. It is beta: each operation carries its stability level, and breaking changes follow the notice rules on the changelog page at /docs/api/changelog.
info.title: Tiehall API

parameters.description: A key of your choice that makes a retried POST run once: a repeat with the same key and body within 24 hours gets the first response, and the same key with another body gets 422 (draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header).
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: A key of your choice that makes a retried POST run once: a repeat with the same key and body within 24 hours gets the first response, and the same key with another body gets 422 (draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header).

400.description: The input fails the operation's schema, or is outside what the install's settings allow, or the tiehall CLI that sent it is older than the install supports (upgrade-required).

401.description: The call carries no valid token.

403.description: The caller may not take this action.

404.description: There is no such operation, or the record the call names does not exist.

409.description: The request's state does not allow this action.

413.description: The request body is larger than 2 MiB, the limit on this operation's body; it is not read, and nothing runs.

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was sent with a different body in the last 24 hours.

429.description: A limit is exceeded; retry after the time Retry-After gives.

Retry-After.description: The seconds to wait before retrying.

schema.description: The seconds to wait before retrying.

503.description: Setup is not complete, or Tiehall is shutting down, or one web process is already receiving as many request bodies as it holds at once (busy): the body was not read and nothing ran; retry after the time Retry-After gives.

Retry-After.description: The seconds to wait before retrying.

post.summary: Open a request to a team.
